scripts.dev: concurrently -n web,api -c green,cyan "npm run dev:web" "npm run dev:api"
scripts.build: npm run build --workspace=apps/web && npm run build --workspace=apps/api
scripts.start: concurrently -n web,api -c green,cyan "npm run preview --workspace=apps/web" "npm run start:prod --workspace=apps/api"
scripts.install:all: npm install && npm install --workspace=apps/web && npm install --workspace=apps/api
